description: ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN judges a DEFAULT far more strictly than CREATE TABLE (live-measured): only bare literals (a cast is echoed in CAST spelling, even CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() refused), the literal's type must be in the column's FAMILY with no coercion (datetime columns take only NULL; the literal is spelled with its own measurements), length/precision are not judged, VARIANT falls through to the coercion sentence, OBJECT/ARRAY/GEOGRAPHY/GEOMETRY/FILE judge nothing, MAP/VECTOR accept no literal, a negative number is a literal, and BINARY takes no default at all. Converted 1:1 from ddl/AddColumnDefaultTypeTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE ac_t (id NUMBER)
ALTER TABLE ac_t ADD COLUMN c1 NUMBER DEFAULT 1 + 1

error.messageContains:
SQL compilation error:
Invalid column default expression [1 + 1]
